title: Without coupling to a structured world there is no experience

statements.text: Beliefs have coherence because they have semantic content from evolving through interactions with a coherently structured world. A system without those meaningful external connections could have arbitrarily large integrative potential and still be nothing that it is like to be.

sources.quote: Without those meaningful external connections, systems could have arbitrarily large amounts of integrative potential, but there still may be nothing that it is like to be such systems.
